title: INFRA — Fix Phase 1.5 gate display + wire Phase 2A gate into PM2
rationale: Two small fixes: (1) update-gate-tracker.ts reads gateData from phase1-5-gate.json but doesn't use overall_pass — it recalculates manually (postCount>=30 && totalViews>=500), showing Pending even though overall_pass=true. Fix: use gateData.overall_pass. (2) generate-phase2a-gate.ts was created in Sprint 1445 but has no PM2 cron to run daily — add it to ecosystem.config.js alongside the existing kognai-gate-regen process.

tasks.description: Fix scripts/update-gate-tracker.ts: replace manual phase15Pass calculation (postCount>=30 && totalViews>=500) with gateData?.overall_pass===true. This uses the authoritative phase1-5-gate.json which correctly marks views as null (unverifiable) when TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set. Also update phase15Notes to use the more accurate data from gateData.

Add generate-phase2a-gate.ts to ecosystem.config.js as a PM2 cron process. Name: 'kognai-phase2a-gate-regen'. Run daily at 06:56 UTC (after gate-regen at 06:55, before gate-tracker-update at 07:08). Script: scripts/generate-phase2a-gate.ts. Same pattern as existing kognai-gate-regen entry. This ensures workspace/gates/phase1-phase2a-gate.json is always fresh when the gate-tracker-update runs.
